description: Guided opt-out fer USA-Official. A sailor follows the steps on the checklist; OpenOptOut hands over a one-time email address an' clicks any confirmation link.
instructions: Open https://usa-official.com, search fer {full_name}, open yer own record an' use the site's opt-out or "Control" link on it. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks fer an email address. Then smash "I've done this".
